title: Audit diagnostic Boolean-CSR construction against the canonical multi-relation compiler

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit only the two diagnostic Boolean-CSR construction probes named by GPU-74. Determine whether repeated single-signature construction is intentional measurement semantics or removable overhead now that compile_relation_blocks is the sole implementation owner. Do not change production code, probe code, public API, benchmark claims, promotion state or branch topology in this packet.

relation_cost_probe.observation: The builder calls boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold once for code:imports:code and once for code:documents:knowledge. Since GPU-71/72 the facade directly delegates each call to compile_relation_blocks, so one measured CSR subject performs two independent Forest/Fourfold admission and relation-compilation passes.

heldout_csr_probe.observation: The held-out builder maps four signatures through boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold. The retained facade delegates each signature independently, so one measured held-out CSR subject performs four independent canonical compiler passes before Boolean matmul/hadamard query work begins.

historical_intent.relation_arm_commit_message: G1-TENSOR-01CM add strict CSR arm to relation cost probe
historical_intent.heldout_arm_commit_message: G1-TENSOR-01CR add held-out Fourfold CSR falsification probe
historical_intent.finding: The historical commits define the arms as strict/Fourfold Boolean CSR representations and falsification probes. They do not freeze repeated public-facade invocation count as part of the workload contract. The per-signature repetition was therefore an implementation detail of the then-available construction path, not an explicit research variable.

decision.canonical_replacement: Compile the complete frozen signature tuple once with compile_relation_blocks(forest, fourfold, BooleanSemiring(), signatures=signatures), then recover blocks from that one CompiledRelationBlocks receipt in the probe's frozen signature order.
decision.measurement_schema_rule: Because construction cost changes materially when repeated compiler admission/scans are removed, both diagnostic probe schemas must be version-bumped in the implementation packet. Historical /5 relation-probe and /1 held-out-CSR measurements remain valid evidence for their old construction semantics and must not be silently relabelled or compared as if identical.
decision.compatibility_rule: Do not remove boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold. Keep its existing public compatibility coverage outside the diagnostic construction arms; the probe migration must not become a pretext for a breaking API change.
decision.summary: The two diagnostic CSR arms are measuring a canonical sparse representation, not the overhead of invoking the single-relation compatibility facade repeatedly. Their 2-pass and 4-pass compiler construction is removable benchmark harness overhead.
